{{Top|leg}}
'''Household boars''' or '''tuskers''' were [[Gamorrean/Legends|Gamorreans]] who were unmarried and hired into a clan. They formed the bulk of the clan armies, working for a stipend from the [[Matron/Legends|matron]] and whatever plunder they could loot from rival clans. Household boars were not totally loyal to their clan, but successful ones could hope to secure [[Marriage/Legends|marriage]] to a sow, possibly even a [[Matron/Legends|matron]].
